entries.1d03959a34322565: This is a business selling foods, sake, wine and the like through mail order. The food gift genre performed well, and wholesale also increased. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥33,295 million.
entries.353312138dfb3b26: A business that provides mail-order sales for nurses and nurse placement services. Subsidiary Nurse Stage Co., Ltd. runs mail-order sales for nurses, and JOBSTUDIO PTE.LTD. of Singapore provides nurse placement services. The unprofitable nurse career website “Nurse Career Next” ended its service in June 2025. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12,304 million.
entries.4094f14e71417ee7: BELLUNA is a company that sells clothing, household goods, food, cosmetics and other products, mainly through mail order by catalog and the internet, and also operates businesses such as real estate and hotels.
entries.552416622acc8fe9: This is a business selling clothing, household goods such as miscellaneous goods and furniture, and personal and hobby goods, through catalog and internet mail-order sales, internet-only mail-order sales and apparel stores, centered on mature women. Subsidiaries Aishinetto Co., Ltd., Marunaga Co., Ltd. and Serekuto Co., Ltd. also conduct this business. The unprofitable fashion EC mall and imported brand EC site services have been terminated. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥68,804 million, the largest business in consolidated revenue.
entries.828228a50ecaef80: A business that sells Japanese-style related products through stores, and a business that rents formal wear such as hakama for graduation ceremonies. Subsidiaries such as BANKAN Wamonoya Co., Ltd., Saga-mi Co., Ltd. and Tokyo Masuiwaya Co., Ltd. handle sales of Japanese-style clothing, and Maimu Co., Ltd. handles costume rental. In costume rental, orders for graduation hakama rentals increased. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥22,467 million.
entries.9689351600713c50: A business that sells cosmetics and health foods through mail order. Subsidiary Ojio Co., Ltd. sells cosmetics and other products, and Rifure Co., Ltd. sells health foods and other products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥11,438 million.
entries.a3942d42f13f5b13: Leveraging the customer base built through mail-order sales, this business provides inserting and co-mailing services, mail-order outsourcing services, and the logistics 3PL business. Subsidiary Sunstage Co., Ltd. mainly conducts finance business for customers of the mail-order business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥17,890 million.
entries.aa959322824c4e8e: This is a business that conducts leasing, development and sales of office buildings and other real estate, as well as hotel, power generation, golf course operation and restaurant businesses. In domestic hotels, Sapporo Hotel by Granbell and Otaru Granbell Hotel, which opened in July 2025, have performed well, and in September 2025 the company acquired Hotel Zuiho and Akiu Grand Hotel at Akiu Onsen. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥49,106 million.
entries.e7e37cff8b481ba6: A business that conducts wholesale business centered on apparel and a travel agency business, among others. Subsidiary Friendly Co., Ltd. conducts wholesale, and the company has decided to withdraw from wholesale on a consignment sales basis. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,791 million.
